_setup_note: Configure each server below. Install the official MCP package for each service, then replace placeholder values. Env vars reference your backend/.env file.

jira._note: Official Jira MCP server — configure command from the official MCP registry. This app reads the Xray test repository via jiraXrayClient.js (Basic auth: JIRA_USER:JIRA_API_TOKEN). Bug creation goes to Neutara, not Jira.

mongodb._note: Official MongoDB Atlas MCP server. Connects to the migration_qa database (MONGODB_DB_NAME). Collections: test_repository, test_expanded_details, connected_accounts, test_repository_local_folders, test_repository_local_tests. Note: executions are stored on disk in backend/data/executions.json (not MongoDB).
